title: TopologyRelationshipLayerMetadata
description: Typed metadata for an overlay layer produced from a topology relationship. It keeps relationship identity and qualifiers visible for UI controls, save policy, and diagnostics without requiring result chaining.

relationshipId.description: Stable topology relationship id that produced the layer.

catalogIds.description: Semantic catalog ids associated with the relationship layer, when known.

renderMode.description: Render mode used by topology-service for this materialized layer.

qualifiers.description: Relationship qualifiers used to produce this layer.

sourceSummary.description: Human-readable summary of the source used for this layer, for example current VLAN view, selected LAG edge, or all visible site links.

activeInstanceId.description: Optional active relationship instance id when this layer corresponds to an advertised active relationship.
